# stackit_containerregistry_artifactories (Data Source)

Container registry artifactories list data source schema.

## Example Usage

```terraform
locals {
  project_id = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
}

data "stackit_containerregistry_artifactories" "this" {
  project_id = local.project_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) STACKIT project ID to which the container registry artifactories are associated.

### Optional

- `region` (String) STACKIT region where the container registry artifactories are located. If not defined, the provider default_region is used.

### Read-Only

- `artifactories` (Attributes List) List of container registry artifactories. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--artifactories))
- `id` (String) Terraform's internal data source ID, structured as `project_id`,`region`.

<a id="nestedatt--artifactories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `artifactories`

Read-Only:

- `artifactory_id` (String) The unique identifier of the container registry artifactory.
- `create_time` (String) The date and time the creation of the STACKIT artifactory was triggered.
- `name` (String) A user-chosen name to distinguish multiple STACKIT artifactories.
- `proxy` (Attributes) Proxy configuration if this artifactory is created as a proxy-cache for an upstream registry. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--artifactories--proxy))
- `state` (String) The current state of the STACKIT artifactory.
- `url` (String) The base URL of the STACKIT artifactory.

<a id="nestedatt--artifactories--proxy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `artifactories.proxy`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the upstream registry.
- `registry_type` (String) Which replication adapter to use for this registry.
- `url` (String) Upstream registry URL to proxy.
